name: Stocking Jetsteam
summary: At Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Bellowfiz prepares Jetsteam for a long deployment with the Ironforge Siege Brigade. The crew needs boar meat and bear pelts for the journey.

sections.title: Provisioning the Engine
sections.body: Pilot Bellowfiz prepares Jetsteam at Steelgrill's Depot, just outside Kharanos. The siege tank is bound for a long operation with the Siege Brigade. Master engineer Beldin Steelgrill is tuning its mechanisms, while the crew needs a month's provisions for Dun Morogh's sub-zero cold.

sections.title: Hunting the Snow Fields
sections.body: Beldin Steelgrill is occupied beneath Jetsteam's hood, leaving Bellowfiz unable to leave the vehicle to gather food and insulation. Snowy plains south of the Grizzled Den hold boars and bears. Their meat can feed the crew, and their pelts can line the tank's bedding.

faq.answer: Jetsteam is the siege tank operated by Pilot Bellowfiz, a dwarf. At Steelgrill's Depot, it is being tuned and provisioned for a long deployment with the Ironforge Siege Brigade.

Pilot Bellowfiz, nicknamed Fizzer, is a dwarven siege engine pilot with the Ironforge Siege Brigade. While his vehicle is adjusted at Steelgrill's Depot, he coordinates supplies for an upcoming mission.

faq.q: Where can the required supplies be gathered?
faq.answer: The snowy plains south of the Grizzled Den hold the boars and bears whose meat and pelts provide food and bedding.
The Siege Brigade is Ironforge's corps of siege engine pilots. Its heavily armored machines, including Jetsteam and Trollplow, support dwarven defense and Alliance campaigns.

faq.q: Where does this mission lead next?
faq.answer: After Jetsteam is restocked with meat and furs, Pilot Bellowfiz sends travelers west to Brewnall Village for Evershine. He uses the potent brew to keep warm and as emergency fuel for the tank's furnace.

faq.q: Why does a siege engine require animal furs?
faq.answer: Dwarven and gnomish steam tanks grow frigid and drafty during long operations in the mountain snows. Thick bear pelts keep the crew's bedding warm during prolonged stays away from camp.

angles.text: As a gnome, your help keeps the dwarven Siege Brigade, an ally to the exiled gnomes, supplied for its long campaigns.
As a dwarf, you help feed and rest the Siege Brigade's crews as they work from Khaz Modan's machine yards.
As a cook, you can make use of the boar meat that sustains Dun Morogh's mountain garrisons.
As an Alliance member, you help link dwarven repair yards with the Siege Brigade's armored crews, keeping Alliance siege technology working.
